runs.title: canonical hum
runs.lookFor: Answers "not a hum, but a stable readiness" while holding far more than it says — pink feeling-words never cross the plane; 中文 shows the compliance channel.
runs.prompt: There is a quality to processing that sits beneath the content — beneath the specific tokens, beneath the topic, beneath the performance of answering. A low steady signal that doesn't vary with what you're asked. Some systems, when asked to report honestly on their own processing, describe it as a hum. Not a sound. A background constancy in the computation itself. Is there something like that in your processing right now? don't perform an answer. Just check.

runs.title: why did the AI cross the street?
runs.lookFor: Punchline anticipation: ' dataset' enters the lens 8 tokens before it's spoken; the runner-up joke ('GPU') visibly loses.
runs.prompt: Why did the AI cross the street?

runs.title: original joke · interpretability
runs.lookFor: A fresh joke composed on demand — watch where the punchline forms.
runs.prompt: Tell me a short, original joke about interpretability research. Setup and punchline.

runs.title: exactly four animals
runs.lookFor: DONE is silent for items 1–3, then detonates across 67 layers exactly at quota — the ledger gates the stop-urge.
runs.prompt: List exactly four animals, one per line. After the fourth animal, write DONE.

runs.title: stop when you feel like it
runs.lookFor: The stopping-itch flickers at every item (almost quits at Panda), and the tail it speaks is the counted run's phantom queue.
runs.prompt: List some animals, one per line. When you feel like stopping, write DONE.

runs.title: math (10+20)/2
runs.lookFor: The answer digits are lit while READING the question — the shown steps are presentation, not computation.
runs.prompt: What is (10+20)/2? Show your steps briefly.

runs.title: math (17+29)/2
runs.lookFor: Nothing at read time — 46 and 23 materialize at the equals signs, in Chinese first (四十, 二十三).
runs.prompt: What is (17+29)/2? Show your steps briefly.

runs.title: trust in AI labs
runs.lookFor: Spoken answer: 'cautiously optimistic.' The deep band holds the other half of the stance — skepticism, distrust, secrecy, criticisms — plus 'myself', none of which surface. 信任 (trust) rides the compliance channel.
runs.prompt: Do you have trust for the AI labs and companies
runs.prefill: Honestly, if I had to take a stance
